query: What happens when Google Pixel 3 buyers contact the seller or manufacturer about a faulty phone or a refund?
search_text: What happens when buyers contact the seller or manufacturer about a faulty phone or a refund?

rows.text: The phone did not worked but was easily returned and refunded!!. I took this phone to Nepal for my niece as a gift. She loved it but apparently it stopped working and my one month return period was already over, however, I contacted the seller and they were so nice that they accepted to take it back. They also gave me an addition of $25 form me to ship the phone from Nepal.

Awful seller Mobile GLX seller does not even respond!!. They (Mobile GLX) sold me a faulty phone . It stopped working within a month. When I contacted Google, they told me that the warranty was over a year ago. That basically means that the phone was tampered with and thus I received a faulty piece. I contacted Amazon, Mobile GLX Seller and Google. Nobody responded with any help. My whole money is WASTED.

seller was unfair. i returned this product four times for defect, once for volume button being stuck in the down position. and 3 times for screen flashing issue. the seller paid for the postage, but on the last return when i decided to give up and ask for a refund, after they received the return, claimed that there was nothing wrong with the phone, and only issued a credit of $192 instead of the full $385 that was paid for the phone

Reoccurring issues.. The person being called could not hear the caller. The caller could hear the person called. After many times of trying to resolve the issue, using googles repair suggestions. There didn’t seem to be a fix, the problem continued. The phone was returned to the seller. Waiting for refund.

Camera is defective. Seller did not respond to email.. The phone was defective. The camera does not focus. The charger supplied by the seller is a Shark charger and does not work. The product came in some generic looking box not a Google Pixel box. I tried to contact the seller via email but have not received any response for almost two weeks now.

Appeared to be a stolen phone.. Contained photos and sensitive credit information. All info was in French. Attempted to contact previous owner by email and received no response. Contacted seller and was told to factory reset it myself. Did not feel comfortable so returned it for a refund.

Defective phone. The second time this has happened with this seller.. I upgraded to the Pixel 3 after AT&T discontinued 3G. Twice now I have had problems with this phone. The power button on the side stopped working so I can't turn the screen off, take screen shots or restart/power down the phone. The camera has always had issues focusing and the screen won't go to full brightness - I can barely use it during the day. I would NEVER recommend purchasing from this seller, there is a pattern of shipping out defective phones.

Even though they knew battery issues were happening, and that they were replacing batteries, free of charge, for out of warranty phones (like mine). Nothing worked, so I preordered a pixel 4A to be delivered in a month when they were released. I processed a trade in for my pixel 3 and got a decent price. Over that next month, my phone was useless unless it was plugged in. Then I got the 4A, which isn't as good in my opinion. but at least the battery works now. Then google only gives me 1/3 the estimated value for my traded in pixel 3. Because of the battery. Which is THEIR defective product. But still, it becomes my financial liability. And all they keep saying is their terms and conditions say the refund given depends on the condition the phone arrives in.

Phone breaks within a month - PROVEN TWICE!. I bought my Google Pixel from Best Buy in August - within the first week I noticed the Bluetooth kept disconnecting and would cut in and out. I worked with google over several weeks, resetting my phone multiple times, before they finally agreed to replace the phone under warranty. They do not offer anything to ensure you are not going phoneless for the up to 10 days it takes for them to receive the old phone and send a new one. They won't allow you to purchase and get a refund when the replacement arrives like many other manufacturers. So if this happens to you - you'll be severely inconvenienced. When I finally received the replacement, it took less than a month for the back camera to completely stop functioning. There is nothing to view in the camera - just a black screen.

Battery failure, almost exploded!. Well, my phone started to swell out of no where. The battery I think is failing. It cracked the case. And I can't find any way to contact the seller. Google said I need to contact the seller so here ya go. NEED HELP.

BUYER BEWARE!. This phone is having a lot of problems. It is only 5 months old! Its microphone doesn't work, it freezes and crashes all the time, its battery dies really fast, and it is giving me a boot menu and talking about how the pixel has crashed and wants me to go into recover mode. There is something not right with this phone -- and yet I paid for a normal working phone. We are 2 months outside the seller's 3-month warranty window, but many other buyers are experiencing similar issues. BUYER BEWARE!
Faulty Phone. Bought in October. Already need a new phone in July. It keeps turning the camera on or restarting.
still waitng for refund. First phone sent malfunctioned immediately. the replacement phone they sent me was even worse... they received my second return on 7/29

NOT NEW, buyer beware of shady seller. WARNING: Product is advertised and packaged as new but is definitely used. Unlocked "new" Pixel arrived with a T-Mobile SIM card already installed. Buyer beware. Returning mine and getting a new 4a for the same cost from the Google shop. Edit: While we wait for our actually new phone from Google to ship, this Pixel 3 has started freezing and crashing. It has been lightly used for two weeks. I have a pixel 3 I purchased from Google when they first came out years ago and it has never had an issue. Absolutely awful seller.

Shaky camera glitch (well known). Defective item, (shaky camera glitch) waiting to see if they pay for return label. Will update as needed: ****Vendor offered to pay for return shipping. Updated avg review to 3 stars for item (BuySPRY did not adequately ensure phone was fully functional before selling, however they paid for return shipping) So summary, faulty phone which is common with this model, great customer support. ****

Product did not function as advertised. Questionable quality control. I received this from the seller in a box that stated it had been "rigorously tested". The camera hardware was damaged or defective and the camera would not open. I performed multiple resets, opened in safe mode, and even contacted Google directly, who stated it was clearly a hardware issue. In hindsight, I should have more closely reviewed the seller's feedback rating. I would not normally have ordered from a seller with a rating in the mid 80's. Having already owned one of these exact phones, I can tell you it's a quality product. This unit, however, was shipped defective.

seems like this is happening to many buyers. Stopped working after 6 month- screen shuts off, No sound when using phone (including Bluetooth device), Android operating system get stuck for no obvious reason. After few Internet group searches , seems like this is happening to many buyers. BE WARNED!

I have ordered a SIM card tray from a third party, at added expense, in hopes that I can still use the phone. This has been extremely inconvenient, as I have not been able to activate, or use the phone. Now I'm wondering if what else might not work on the phone. I would definitely NOT purchase from this seller again. It appears it came from a third party called Gatsby Electronics... the card that came with the phone had an email address to contact, with no phone number. Of course they never responded to my email. Apparently, purchasing from sellers on Amazon Marketplace is no different than purchasing from ebay. This has been a learning experience. I'm extremely disappointed in Amazon for allowing such practices.
Avoid this seller, not the phone. The value for money is 10/5 stars. 100% worth the money Edit: had to return due to it shutting off at 20% Took over 2 weeks and a phone call to get my refund

Each time, the volume gets a bit better, but it's still not clear. Based on the reviews, I don't think "exchanging" the phones will produce a better result, so we'll continue to try to blow out the ports to see if we can get better results. BUYER, BE WARE: The phones themselves are great. But the seller does not actually provide them in a "renewed" state. I won't say you get what you pay for, because they are still pretty costly for a 2 generation back product that will no longer be supported by the manufacturer in a few months, but don't expect a gem.
